links.outcome: Output consistency across repeated runs (Pass^k) of LLM agents on EHR tasks
links.effect: Pass^k consistency drops below 50% for nearly all evaluated models at k=4; top model reached only 62.3% exact-match accuracy.
links.quote: Pass^k consistency drops below 50% for nearly all evaluated models at k=4, exposing broad stochastic fragility.

screen.reason: The paper introduces EHR-Complex, a benchmark dataset and environment derived from MIMIC-IV to test clinical agents on complex database reasoning and code execution, analyzing failure modes without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
